title: Chrome, Firefox Updates Patch Over 180 Vulnerabilities
description: Google Chrome 157 and Mozilla Firefox 160 updates address over 180 security vulnerabilities combined. Chrome 157 fixes 83 flaws including five critical use-after-free issues and multiple high-severity bugs such as out-of-bounds read/write and type confusion. Firefox 160 patches 99 vulnerabilities, including 57 high-severity issues like use-after-free, sandbox escapes, and privilege escalations. No exploitation in the wild has been reported for these vulnerabilities.
